plan: A swordsman who splits in two: his spirit leaves his body to attack, then returns and repeats the damage.
aSurveiller: His R (Fate Sealed). He teleports behind the last champion in a line and pulls in every enemy hit: don't line up.
contrer: Don't line up in front of him: his R pulls in everyone in the line.
When his spirit (E) comes out, back off: at the end he returns to his body and repeats the damage.
Use your crowd control after his charged Q: he can no longer escape.
forces: Very mobile with his charged Q and his E.
His R starts a fight on several enemies.
Strong in duels with his critical strikes.
faiblesses: His E brings him back to his starting point.
Low damage if he falls behind.

sorts.P: Every other attack deals magic damage; more critical strikes.
sorts.Q: Strike in a line; on the 3rd, he dashes and knocks up.
sorts.W: Cone strike that gives him a shield.
sorts.E: His spirit leaves his body, then returns, repeating part of the damage.
sorts.R: Teleports behind a line of enemies and pulls them in.

momentFort: He scales with his critical strike items and becomes fearsome in the late game.
